$description: Hand-authored named surface presets — what the layer IS semantically. Each entry is an alias to a glass or matte leaf via the DTCG curly-brace reference syntax (§ 9.1) — the reference expands to the full token `$value` at resolution time.

surface.$description: Named surface presets — what the layer IS. Aliases to glass/matte leaves.

base.$description: App background — the deepest surface in the stacking order.

raised.$description: Card, panel on top of base.

overlay.$description: Dialog, popover, dropdown — surfaces that hover above the main flow.

frosted.$description: Frosted glass toolbar, header — light-mode surface tint.

inset.$description: Inset well, input background — opaque recess.

primary.$description: Generic primary surface — alias of base for layout flexibility.
